HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials 3.2 Textile Fibres 3.3 Clothing Constructi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Sewing Tools, Equipment and Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Textile Fibres 3.3 Clothing Construction Processes: Stitches 3.4 Clothing Constr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
